description: This file implements the TaskContext class for managing task execution, progress updates, abort handling, timeouts, and cleanup in the Superset project. It includes methods for updating task state, registering handlers, managing abort listeners, handling timeouts, and reporting failures.

classes.name: TaskContext
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TaskContext for managing task lifecycle, progress, aborts, timeouts, and cleanup in the Superset async task framework.

methods.name: _refresh_task
methods.description: Fetches the latest task data from the database and updates internal caches.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Atomically updates task progress and payload, with throttling to limit database writes.

methods.name: _write_to_db
methods.description: Performs the actual database update of task properties and payload.

methods.name: _deferred_flush
methods.description: Flushes pending updates after throttle interval.

methods.name: _cancel_deferred_flush_timer
methods.description: Cancels the deferred flush timer if active.

methods.name: on_cleanup
methods.description: Registers a cleanup handler to run when the task ends.

methods.name: on_abort
methods.description: Registers an abort handler and starts background abort listening if it's the first handler.

methods.name: _set_abortable
methods.description: Marks the task as abortable in the database.

methods.name: _start_abort_listener
methods.description: Starts background abort listening via TaskManager.

methods.name: _on_abort_detected
methods.description: Callback invoked when an abort is detected, triggers abort handlers.

methods.name: mark_execution_completed
methods.description: Marks that the main task execution has finished.

methods.name: start_abort_polling
methods.description: Starts background abort polling, delegating to _start_abort_listener.

methods.name: _trigger_abort_handlers
methods.description: Executes all registered abort handlers, collecting failures.

methods.name: _write_handler_failures_to_db
methods.description: Writes collected abort and cleanup failures to the database as a unified error record.

methods.name: stop_abort_polling
methods.description: Stops the background abort listener.

methods.name: start_timeout_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer to trigger abort on timeout, transitioning task to ABORTING if abortable.

methods.name: stop_timeout_timer
methods.description: Cancels the timeout timer.

methods.name: timeout_triggered
methods.description: Property indicating if the timeout was triggered.

methods.name: abort_handlers_completed
methods.description: Property indicating if all abort handlers have completed successfully.

methods.name: _run_cleanup
methods.description: Runs cleanup handlers, abort handlers if needed, flushes pending updates, and reports failures.
